entry.title: Cyprus resident handbook
entry.summary: Questions people ask after moving: the tax number, the yellow slip and the pink slip, GESY, the income-tax return, and the other registrations that follow.

entry.title: How to get a Cyprus tax identification code
entry.summary: The Tax Department issues the number through Tax For All. You create an account, then register as a taxpayer, and you attach the documents on the Department’s own list.

entry.title: Yellow slip (MEU1) and pink slip in Cyprus
entry.summary: The yellow slip is the MEU1 registration certificate for an EU, EEA or Swiss citizen. The pink slip is a visitor’s temporary residence permit, form MVIS8, for a third-country national. They are not the same application.

entry.title: How to register for GESY and choose a personal doctor
entry.summary: The Health Insurance Organisation says healthcare under GESY needs two registrations: the beneficiary registry, and a personal doctor’s list.

entry.title: Filing a personal income-tax return in Cyprus
entry.summary: From the 2026 tax year the return is filed only in Tax For All. The statutory deadline is 31 July of the next year, unless the Council of Ministers extends it. The 2025 return is due on 31 October 2026.

entry.title: How to get a social insurance number in Cyprus
entry.summary: The Social Insurance Services issue the number when a person is gainfully occupied, as an employee or as self-employed. Arrival alone does not create one.

entry.title: Opening a bank account in Cyprus
entry.summary: A consumer who legally resides in the European Union has a right of access to a payment account with basic features. A mortgage, and the papers a particular bank asks for, are a separate decision. This page does not invent a document list.

entry.title: Exchanging a foreign driving licence in Cyprus
entry.summary: An EU licence may be exchanged after six months, if you choose. A licence from a country the Road Transport Department treats as equivalent must be exchanged after six months. The application is form TOM 7D, in person.

entry.title: Registering a car in Cyprus
entry.summary: A vehicle is cleared by Customs and then registered with the Road Transport Department before it can be licensed for road tax. A car already on the Cyprus register changes owner on form TOM 9B.

entry.title: Electricity and water when you move into a Cyprus home
entry.summary: Electricity is the Electricity Authority of Cyprus. Water is the board or the community of the town, not one national supplier. Deposits exist. This page does not print a typical deposit.

entry.title: Mortgage: Cyprus, Germany, Greece and Spain
entry.summary: The European Central Bank’s average rate on new euro housing loans in September 2026, the Central Bank of Cyprus loan-to-value ceilings, and the purchase taxes each country actually publishes.

entry.title: Moving to Cyprus
entry.summary: A short set of guides for the move itself: the first months, the residence routes, and the tax questions that are not the same as a residence card.

entry.title: The first months after you arrive in Cyprus
entry.summary: A practical order for the first months. The legal clocks are the ones the departments publish: four months for a yellow slip, before the visa expires for a pink slip, not a homemade 30-60-90 timetable.

entry.title: Residence options: EU citizens and third-country nationals
entry.summary: A Union citizen uses the MEU1 registration certificate. A third-country visitor uses the MVIS8 permit and may not work. An investment permit under Regulation 6(2) is a third route, with its own money tests.

entry.title: Cost and tax when you move to Cyprus
entry.summary: Tax residence is the 60-day or 183-day rule. The 2026 bands start at €22,000. A move does not by itself create non-dom status, and this page does not invent a cost of living.

entry.title: A single Cyprus water tariff, before the cabinet on 17 November 2026
entry.summary: On 17 November 2026 the interior ministry asked the cabinet to approve one water scale for the whole island, including a charge on new development. The reports that day said the texts were not yet law.
